pr_body:
Motivation:

To reduce overhead we should use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT when possible.

Modifications:

- Add code to use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT
- Fix bug related to cancellations that are inflight

Result:

Be able to use IORING_RECV_MULTISHOT to reduce overhead if kernel supports it
pr_comment: This was much harder then what I expected... the state machine is quite complex due the possibilities of cancellations that are in-flight
Let me merge this as it also fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14819
